children: Concrete-leveling equipment maker's H1 2026 revenue grew 22% yr/yr to $48.7 mln
Adjusted EPS for H1 2026 doubled yr/yr to $0.12
Company expanded share buyback program and raised FY26 revenue guidance
Somero raises FY26 revenue guidance to about $95 mln
Company expects FY26 adjusted EBITDA of about $19.5 mln
Somero anticipates FY26 year-end net cash of about $29 mln
REGIONAL AND PRODUCT GROWTH - Revenue growth was driven by higher sales across all regions, led by North America, and strong demand for Boomed screeds, Ride-on screeds, and the 3-D Profiler System
NEW CUSTOMER ACQUISITION - Increased sales to new customers contributed to revenue, with new customers accounting for 28% of direct machine revenue
OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY - Pricing actions, operational efficiencies and disciplined cost management helped offset higher input costs and maintain gross margin
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the heavy machinery & vehicles peer group is "buy."
